statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
CPT code 93229 (Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring) was billed
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period
The procedure is indicated to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant arrhythmias
